note: A FIXTURE executable capability (knowledge graphs, Slice C2): the negative example of the property 'isolation is never claimed without code evidence' (graph.mjs bubbleComponent, Slice C1). The SDK seat was that example until its jail made its bubble hold; this fixture stands in its place. capability-graph.test.mjs adds it to a COPY of the real registries (its profile under profiles.fixture-unquoted, its serving rule appended); it is never part of the graph. Its sandbox claims to hold with a quote the code does not contain; its other components hold or do not apply on quotes the code does contain. `found` is a quote the code does contain, for the control: the same claim with it holds.
